meta.name: wispr-analytics
meta.description: This skill should be used when analyzing Wispr Flow voice dictation history for self-reflection, work patterns, mental health insights, or productivity analytics. Triggered by requests like "/wispr-analytics", "analyze my dictations", "what did I dictate today", "wispr reflection", or any request to review voice dictation patterns. Supports modes - technical (coding/work), soft (communication), trends (volume/frequency), mental (sentiment/energy/rumination).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析语音听写记录,洞察工作与心理模式
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常用语音听写,想从中发现自己的工作和情绪规律。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze voice dictation history for work patterns and self-reflection.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently use voice dictation and want to uncover patterns in your work and emotions.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以分析你本地的 Wispr Flow 语音听写历史，生成包含统计数据和文字分析的反思报告，帮助你了解工作模式、沟通习惯和情绪趋势。
howto.when: 当你要求分析语音听写记录，例如说“分析我的听写”、“我今天听写了什么”或“/wispr-analytics”时触发。

say.text: 分析我今天的听写记录
say.note: Claude 会提取今日数据并生成统计和文字分析。

say.text: 用技术模式分析上周的听写
say.note: Claude 会聚焦编程和 AI 工具相关的听写内容。

say.text: 看看我最近的情绪趋势
say.note: Claude 会以心理健康视角分析听写文本。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can analyze your local Wispr Flow voice dictation history, generating a reflection report with quantitative stats and qualitative text analysis to help you understand work patterns, communication habits, and emotional trends.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to analyze dictation history, e.g., "analyze my dictations", "what did I dictate today", or "/wispr-analytics".

say_en.note: Claude will extract today's data and generate stats and analysis.

say_en.text: Analyze last week's dictations in technical mode
say_en.note: Claude will focus on coding and AI tool related dictations.
Claude will analyze dictation text from a mental health perspective.
